title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: archive files classified as one object on Windows
summary: The briefing overstates who is affected: Microsoft's notice limits the change to Windows Endpoint DLP organisations with archive file classification enabled, not every Windows Endpoint DLP organisation. The classification changes, rollout windows, licensing and audit search controls are otherwise supported; two smaller corrections concern attributed advice and checklist controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft is changing Endpoint DLP archive classification on Windows, including .zip and .rar files.
claims.quote: We are updating archive file classification behavior for Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) on Windows endpoints

claims.claim: Archives will be classified directly as a single atomic operation.
claims.quote: Archive files such as .zip and .rar files will be classified directly.- Classification of archive files will occur as a single, atomic operation.

claims.claim: The cited Learn Endpoint DLP page does not describe the new single-object archive reporting behaviour.

claims.claim: The change reaches every organisation that uses Endpoint DLP on Windows.

Who is affected

- Organizations using Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows endpoints with archive file classification enabled
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: 'The change reaches organisations using Endpoint DLP on Windows with archive file classification enabled without anyone choosing the update, and it alters what analysts see rather than what policies decide.' This preserves the qualification in MC1474107 and the Scope section.
